decision: Checked the metric's ceiling: identity 4.73, native AAC 320k 4.72

decision: First run's fixed +4 dB gain pushed hot clips over 0 dBFS; native encoder read 2.9 dB low. Threw the run away and capped gain so the peak lands at -1 dBFS
why: Neutraliser's peak cap prevents overs; a test that clips measures the wrong thing
evidence: diag output in session; run.py gain_db()

decision: ViSQOL and SNR disagreed on libfdk_aac (fdk lower on ViSQOL, +5 dB on SNR). Added a pass with both signals low-passed at 16 kHz and measured each decode's bandwidth
why: fdk cuts at about 16 kHz, native at about 18; the full-band score charges it. A pass that separates bandwidth from in-band quality was the direct test
result: fdk wins in band by 0.02-0.04 at equal rate, loses the top octave
